description: Rebuilt from the Identity Wing's rw_encrypt_then_inhibit, whose name and description required recovery-inhibition tooling but whose rule checked only a 50-write burst. Here both are required, in any order, within 10 minutes: at least 50 files changed or renamed in the user's document folders (file_edited / file_renamed, counting files) and a recovery-inhibition tool run (vssadmin, wbadmin, bcdedit, wmic, diskshadow) - program_run (Prefetch, no account) or process_created (Security 4688).
proves: Files were changed in bulk and recovery was inhibited within minutes, a high-confidence ransomware pattern
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Files changed or renamed in bulk

conditions.value: ^(?:the Desktop|the Documents folder|the Downloads folder|the Pictures folder|the Videos folder|the Music folder|the OneDrive folder)$
